description: This file contains functions and constants for converting AG Grid chart state, filters, sorting, and column configurations into backend-compatible SQL clauses and state representations. It handles complex filter logic, date filtering, and state serialization for AG Grid-based charts in a Superset frontend plugin.

methods.name: escapeStringValue
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in SQL string values to prevent syntax errors and SQL injection.

methods.name: getTextComparator
methods.description: Returns SQL LIKE pattern strings based on filter operator type for text matching.

methods.name: convertDateFilterToSQL
methods.description: Converts AG Grid date filter objects into SQL date comparison clauses, handling various operators and date ranges.

methods.name: convertSortModel
methods.description: Converts AG Grid sort model array into backend sortBy format.

methods.name: convertColumnState
methods.description: Extracts column order from AG Grid column state array.

methods.name: convertFilterToSQL
methods.description: Recursively converts an AG Grid filter object into a SQL WHERE/HAVING clause, supporting complex nested filters.

methods.name: convertFilterModel
methods.description: Converts entire AG Grid filter model into a map of column IDs to SQL filter expressions.

methods.name: convertAgGridStateToOwnState
methods.description: Converts AG Grid chart state into a backend-compatible state object, including sorting, filtering, column order, page size, and current page.
